subject.title: feat(ui): make the sidebar agent chip body the menu trigger

question: Should the sidebar chip become menu-first while preserving an explicit resume action inside every menu state, including the default single-agent state?
rationale: The PR intentionally replaces established chip-body behavior, and the protected maintainer label indicates that the permanent interaction contract needs owner confirmation rather than an automated product choice.

options.title: Menu-first with resume
options.body: Use the chip body as the large menu trigger and add an explicit current-agent resume row for single-agent and multi-agent menus.

options.title: Preserve direct resume
options.body: Keep the chip body as the direct resume action and enlarge or redesign a separate menu trigger without changing the established shortcut.

options.title: Accept menu-only behavior
options.body: Intentionally remove direct resume from the footer and document that conversations are resumed only through agent rows where available.

recommendation.title: Menu-first with resume
recommendation.body: Use the chip body as the large menu trigger and add an explicit current-agent resume row for single-agent and multi-agent menus.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history and current design signals both point to steipete for this Control UI interaction choice.
